The '''Stargazer Uprising''' occurred after the [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] [[Je'daii Journeyer|Journeyer]] [[Dalien Brock]] faked his own [[Death/Legends|death]] in the old Ruins on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and later resurfaced. His sister and fellow Journeyer [[Lanoree Brock]] was tasked with stopping his plans to discover and activate a Hypergate with dark matter. The [[Je'daii Council]] feared this would lead to the formation of a black hole and the destruction of the system.<ref name="Into the Void" />

After fighting in [[Greenwood Station]] on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]], Dalien planted evidence of Je'daii cooperation and even kiled a set of officials, which sparked a war between two domes. Lanoree Brock and [[Tre Sana]] escaped the doomed dome together and eventually caught up with Dalien on Sunspot. After he shot her through the chest on [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]], she recovered using [[Alchemy of flesh|alchemy of the flesh]]. Finally Lanoree, killed her brother in the old ruins and returned to the Je'daii ending the crisis, though several of the benefactors of the Stargazers survived and vanished.<ref name="Into the Void" />
